text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[Hand] [Main] By placing 1 [Loweemon] and 1 [KaiserLeomon] from your trash under 1 of your purple or yellow Tamers, digivolve it into this card for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring digivolution requirements.
＜Jamming＞
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your trash without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.

qa.answer:
A {Hand} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in your hand.
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than your hand.
qa.question: What is a {Hand} effect?

qa.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
In order for the conditions for this card's [Hand] [Main] effect to be met, you must place 1 [Loweemon] and 1 [KaiserLeomon] under your Tamer.
qa.question: Can I use this card's [Hand] [Main] effect to place just 1 [Loweemon] or [KaiserLeomon] from my trash under my Tamer?

qa.answer:
No, it digivolves from the Tamer as-is. It isn't treated as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
In addition, this digivolution requirement can be used to digivolve a Tamer even if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates.
qa.question: Does a digivolution requirement that digivolves from a Tamer mean that the Tamer that will become a digivolution card is treated as a Digimon when it digivolves?

qa.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.
qa.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?

qa.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.
qa.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?

qa.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.
qa.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
